page.layout: One printed page, left of the scan. Running text in one column, with a narrow margin on the left holding the note "Ibidem." beside line 22. Below the text, the catchword "po-" at the right. The right-hand printed page is cut off at the scan edge and is not transcribed.

main_text.p: sto deditissimum Imperatorem acceda-tis, illumq; de omnibus quę contra nos geruntur dilucidè instruatis : Synodi nomine supplicantes, vt ij nobis resti-tuantur, qui nullo modo à Canonibus sunt condemnati ; puta sanctissimi Deoq; dilectissimi Episcopi, Cyrillus & Mem-non, tum vt nostri misertus, primo quo-que tempore ex hoc ergastulo nos li-beret, & si quidem digni sumus qui pi-entissimi Christiq; amantissimi Impe-ratoris faciem videamus, hanc ille no-bis gratiam faciat : si vero indigni[?] iudi-camur, quibus hoc beneficium obtin-gat, saltem bona venia ad Ecclesias no-stras-redire nos sinat, nè hic vniuersi; alij morbis, alij mœstitia consumpti percamus.] Quàm vero vnanimis fue-rit omnium Patrum in Concilio cõgre-gatorum, in hac petitione promouenda consensus, ejusdem testatur Epistolæ conclusio : [Ibidem.{c} Ne autem omnium sub-scriptionibus aliquod vobis fastidium ingereremus, sat nobis fuit, si soli Præ-sides communi omnium nomine sub-scriberent.] Neque huic Synodicæ petitioni dissimilis fuit. Cleri Constantino-politanæ

page.notes: Long s printed as f throughout, rendered as plain s. "indigni" at line 13 is doubtful (the scan may read "indignii"). The left-margin note "c Ibidem." is shown beside line 22 with its reference mark. The running head is "Scutum Regium." with "LIB.III." printed at the top right, which is not included as a running head. The right-hand page is only a cut edge and is not transcribed. Opening word "sto" is a fragment, and the paragraph continues from the previous page.
